H_protocol: H1 literal source-plane events; H2 actual disposition amplification with intensity-transfer limits; H3 actual behavior too dependent on a local punchline to generalize; H4 actual nonliteral behavioral license. Magic, lies, nested fiction, genre assumptions and comic survival do not automatically establish H3/H4. No category quota.
L_protocol: L0 portable propositions; L1 materially important wording/rhythm/tone; L2 pragmatic/register/recipient force; L3 central Japanese form requiring reconstruction or annotation. Ordinary ruby and idioms are not automatically L3.

records.whole_selected_premise: Bedtime care embeds a triumphant solitary hero whose defensive account is punctured by the week needed to invent it.
records.L_rationale: The not-lacking-but-choosing reformulation is contradicted by the villain’s timing reply.
records.H_rationale: Megumin actually reads a fictional tale to her sister; the embedded boast and retaliation stay on that nested plane.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Not a current historical hero identification or an additional actual-world killing.

records.whole_selected_premise: A child’s NEET label defeats the older sister’s careful distinction between having no job and actively seeking one.
records.L_rationale: The tentative corrective jobseeker label receives no uptake beyond a food request.
records.H_rationale: Unemployment and job search coexist with actual breakfast provision.
records.eligibility_and_limits: The insult does not prove unwillingness to work.

records.whole_selected_premise: A grand journey depends on a very ordinary fare that exceeds her savings, while a friendly adviser explicitly excludes money.
records.L_rationale: The generous anything-except-money offer exposes a practical boundary rather than unlimited support.
records.H_rationale: Restricted teleport destinations, 300000 fare and 4000 savings constrain actual options.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Potion-value information is disclosed after graduation, not known at the earlier gift.

records.whole_selected_premise: The would-be genius worker nearly destroys the mana-infusion job with the very magnitude she offers as her qualification.
records.L_rationale: A task requiring controlled input versus excessive output is portable without a Japanese word hinge.
records.H_rationale: The employer freezes the dangerous product and requires practice; her admitted lack of regulation is real.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No completed factory explosion, permanent employment or general inability at all work.

records.whole_selected_premise: A lofty interview motive becomes a ready-made line she accepts, but the available job needs an intact organ her spell cannot preserve.
records.L_rationale: Then-that adopts the employer’s noble phrasing after her practical wage motive is rejected.
records.H_rationale: Job availability and surgical harvest requirements block this particular match.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Drug testing is offered and considered; acceptance or performed testing is not shown.

records.whole_selected_premise: Secret stress relief creates the night terror patrol that exhausts her friend; a friendship alibi meets an explicit refusal of blanket forgiveness.
records.L_rationale: Quoted friendship-as-excuse is directly rejected, then evasive officialese is pressed into actual temporary assent.
records.H_rationale: Repeated casts, dragged recovery, lost sleep, confession and objection are actual.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No literal physiological need for daily casting; external pressure and temporary agreement are distinct.

records.whole_selected_premise: A misunderstood plan for bodily paid work elicits an alarming alternative before the intended drug-testing possibility is clarified.
records.L_rationale: The euphemistic description invites a wrong inference that the exchange explicitly corrects.
records.H_rationale: Yunyun’s concern and proposed alternative are speech acts, not completed sex work or arson.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Non-graphic analysis; corrected misunderstanding is not an event warrant.

records.whole_selected_premise: Practical observation finds a restaurant vacancy, but the observer cannot make the approach and her friend accepts ordinary service work.
records.L_rationale: Finding a vacancy, approaching an owner and doing the task are separable portable capacities.
records.H_rationale: Yunyun’s social inhibition and Megumin’s actual application coexist with culinary experience.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Neither whole-person incompetence nor effortless genius employment follows.

records.whole_selected_premise: A service persona survives teasing until peers charge their meal to her wages; an actual cast attempt is stopped by customers and retaliation still costs the job.
records.L_rationale: Polite customer address becomes strained, and the later repentance formula is qualified by resentment.
records.H_rationale: Comic amplification escalates wounded pride and wage exploitation into an actual indoor chant and forced hot-food retaliation.
records.eligibility_and_limits: The attempt and coercion remain literal; no completed indoor Explosion or harmlessness exemption.

records.whole_selected_premise: Farmers perform spectacular magic as mundane preparation, then insist on skilled manual harvesting rather than damaged produce.
records.L_rationale: Efficient staged work and preservation of goods travel as a task-sequence contrast.
records.H_rationale: Adult mana expenditure, animated vegetables, both girls’ work and actual 4000 payment are real.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Seasonal work is not a guaranteed continuing fare solution.

records.whole_selected_premise: A date invitation after shared labor recruits the next recovery carrier.
records.L_rationale: The intimate-sounding invitation has an instrumental purpose disclosed by the following excursion.
records.H_rationale: The invitation is actual and Yunyun chooses to accompany her.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Blushing illustration does not establish romance or agreement to every resulting hazard.

records.whole_selected_premise: Flattery praises the carrier’s inability to refuse while the recovered caster has already made their route dangerous.
records.L_rationale: The compliment functions as recruitment and deflection within a real dependency.
records.H_rationale: A blast, fallen drake, spent caster and Yunyun’s carrying are actual.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No independently prepared recovery arrangement or harmless collateral.

records.whole_selected_premise: The rival can defeat one drake but changes to escape when numbers rise, while teasing and hair-pulling make the joint escape worse.

records.H_rationale: Yunyun’s conditional capacity, fall, resumed carrying and scorched uniform retain costs.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Flight does not disprove her capacity against the original single opponent.

records.whole_selected_premise: A self-created patrol problem becomes a heroic encounter with an invented female devil in the culprit’s public account.
records.L_rationale: Formal battle-report style launders the speaker’s own action into a helpful witness narrative.
records.H_rationale: Megumin really lies to Bukkorori and Yunyun objects.
records.eligibility_and_limits: A later real devil does not prove this earlier invented accusation.

records.whole_selected_premise: A supposedly fatal deprivation of daily magic shrinks into bargaining over a two-day ban, followed by an awkward request for tomorrow’s company.

records.H_rationale: The ban, false bargaining claim and Yunyun’s actual desire for another meeting are literal acts of speech.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No genuine withdrawal disease or automatic unlimited forgiveness.

records.whole_selected_premise: A visitor’s reverent address seems to validate Megumin’s secret destiny until its true addressee is revealed.

records.whole_selected_premise: A theatrical awakening narrative answers a servant who explicitly says she has not come for the speaker.

records.H_rationale: Megumin’s willing mistaken self-identification and Arnes’s correction occur in-world.
records.eligibility_and_limits: The invented sealed identity is not new supernatural knowledge.

records.whole_selected_premise: Family membership forbids selling the pet until the exact travel fare is offered; the cat’s refusal then constrains the buyer more than the seller.

records.H_rationale: Paid money, attempted transfer, resistance and one-night deferral are actual.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Payment does not equal completed voluntary transfer; Arnes’s respect-for-will later weakens.

records.whole_selected_premise: A farewell meal and genuine affection coexist with rationalizing a profitable transfer and misreading a visitor as the buyer.

records.whole_selected_premise: The helper keeps yesterday’s work appointment and is hit for interrupting a farewell she was never told about.

records.H_rationale: Forgotten invitation, actual striking, misread money and mutual fight remain consequential.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Neither suspected crime nor intimate work is thereby established.

records.whole_selected_premise: A polite buyer’s respect for the cat gives way to intimidation when the friend asks concrete questions and urges a refund.

records.H_rationale: Yunyun probes purpose, the cat escapes to her and horns expose the visitor’s identity.
records.eligibility_and_limits: A humanoid appearance and a claimed master relation do not prove benign consent.

records.whole_selected_premise: A lethal ultimatum meets an apparently conciliatory cat toss that buys time for an actual call for stronger help.

records.H_rationale: Megumin throws the cat, Yunyun signals adults and Arnes diverts to catch it.
records.eligibility_and_limits: The danger is real; later repetition receives a more dangerous response from the same opponent.

records.whole_selected_premise: The patrol attacks a real devil for a terror story the narrator invented, and the child who contributed little claims the paid sum as loot.

records.H_rationale: Actual powerful rescue and broken wall do not validate the earlier charge or Megumin’s exclusive entitlement.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Arnes’s genuine threat and falsely assigned night attacks must be retained together.

records.whole_selected_premise: A lonely rival organizes the farewell and eagerly hosts a party whose guests initially wound her with their surprise.
records.L_rationale: The friends’ reaction to a first visit reveals a socially painful premise before it softens into celebration.
records.H_rationale: Yunyun’s initiative, preparations and actual hosted event are real.
records.eligibility_and_limits: A promised future birthday party is not another completed occurrence.

records.whole_selected_premise: The peers who once used a medicine request supply a staff and clarify that the illness and treatment were real.
records.L_rationale: A later participant report changes the credibility of the earlier suspicion without rewriting its information time.
records.H_rationale: Funi’s denial of that degree of deception and the material/craft gift are actual.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Participant testimony is not a laboratory verification; earlier EXP01 uncertainty stays historically exact.

records.whole_selected_premise: A supposedly dangerous heirloom becomes a worthless old fashion accessory just after the recipient solemnly accepts all gifts.

records.H_rationale: Arue’s ordinary eyepatch has no claimed magic after clarification; Megumin throws it and takes the new one.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Performed equipment lore grants no actual suppressed power.

records.whole_selected_premise: World-conquering bravado meets a rival’s future promise to stop her, then practical cat care brings a disputed baiting method.
records.L_rationale: The same cherished rival can oppose a boast and object to instrumental food talk.
records.H_rationale: Plans, objections and an unspoken hesitant request remain distinct.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Future devil-king power or a permanent agreed cat arrangement is not demonstrated.

records.whole_selected_premise: The departing sister invites a tearful plea and receives literal acceptance, then one quiet request to return produces the attachment she wanted.
records.L_rationale: Futile means no need to stop you is followed by a concrete come-back-soon request with a different force.
records.H_rationale: Komekko’s actual words, hand-holding and Megumin’s embrace show particular care.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No whole-person absence of attachment inferred from the first practical reply; non-graphic sibling scene.

records.whole_selected_premise: A child gives lunch and her treasured book, while a confessed boast nevertheless becomes another reluctant promise to try.

records.H_rationale: Gifts and affection are actual; the aspirational accomplishment is not.

records.whole_selected_premise: A real childcare request is accepted, then a misleading delicacy formula redirects the father against his son.

records.eligibility_and_limits: The father goes upstairs angry; a specific punishment is unshown.

records.H_rationale: Actual clothing gifts, care arrangements and paid teleport coexist with denied attachment.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Only Arcanretia is reached; future Axel employment and party are not secured.

records.eligibility_and_limits: A park voice is a clue resembling Yunyun, not yet a confirmed reunion or omniscient location.

records.eligibility_and_limits: Only this firing is directly rendered; the ten-job aggregate is not ten separately witnessed scenes.

records.H_rationale: Electoral manipulation and distinct motives conflict in the same procession.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Ten interruptions are reported, but only the supplied examples receive scene-level claims.

records.eligibility_and_limits: Cecily’s powder account is a character claim; do not infer actual ingestion.

records.H_rationale: Cecily changes presentation before a newly freed audience.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No actual bribe acceptance or genuine earlier belief is supplied.

records.whole_selected_premise: A threat to cause pain is welcomed until the threatening stranger is identified as a devil; then the apparently useless priest reflects real fire.

records.H_rationale: Actual attack, reflection and role change reveal specific power.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Unwelcome behavior remains misconduct; capacity does not validate earlier guilt inferences.

records.L_rationale: A convenient culprit claim and later frank amusement have distinct truth status.
records.H_rationale: Actual cruelty and task neglect amplify Zesta’s pleasure-seeking disposition despite overwhelming technical advantage.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No actual Arnes powder theft is proven; survival is not evidence of safe agreed play.

records.whole_selected_premise: Travel money arrives before a proposed bath, while teasing the overlooked friend recruits an actual lightning retaliation.
records.L_rationale: Tourist pretense, changed-my-mind declaration and repeated expectation of company expose unstable face management.
records.H_rationale: Zesta really gives fare; Yunyun actually retaliates and Megumin later wakes.
records.eligibility_and_limits: The bath cast does not cause the earlier payment; unconscious duration is narrator estimate.

records.whole_selected_premise: The caster abandons a thank-you pretext, asks permission for the pleasure she really wants, and enlarges a pool after both users leave.
records.L_rationale: Direct self-interested disclosure and a specific permission request replace a flattering motive story.
records.H_rationale: Permission, distancing and actual successful cast are real.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Local precautions are not proof of independently prepared complete recovery or safe city-wide operation.

records.whole_selected_premise: A genuine blessing is followed by a deliberate refusal to bless the friend, and a heavy farewell gift proves to be recruitment forms.
records.L_rationale: Factual benediction, spiteful exclusion and deceptive gift framing coexist.
records.H_rationale: Megumin receives a real spell and throws back the paper bundle; Yunyun’s request is denied.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No permanent conversion, measured blessing effect or ordinary cash gift.

records.whole_selected_premise: Subjective time excuses monopolizing the window, a cookie is intercepted, and an abstract party-balance judgment misses a personal invitation.
records.L_rationale: My-body-clock correction and generic composition rule answer different actual requests.
records.H_rationale: Resource taking, offered food and Yunyun’s hesitant personal aim remain literal.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No standing rule makes two casters inherently unviable; this is a character appraisal.

records.whole_selected_premise: The desired heroic encounter is disgusting at close range; a panicked chant and using the friend as a shield replace the confident performance.
records.L_rationale: Genius-race authority clashes with the recipient’s explicit do-not-use-me boundary.
records.H_rationale: Yunyun physically stops dangerous casting and actually fights with the guards.
records.eligibility_and_limits: M’s 0.1-percent assertion is not an objective survival statistic.

records.whole_selected_premise: A public hero’s newly assertive rival proposes a contest but drops it when rank is actually put at stake.
records.L_rationale: Immediate acceptance of the offered terms reverses the challenger’s confidence.
records.H_rationale: Megumin initiates then withdraws a real challenge.
records.eligibility_and_limits: The insult is about rank/credit, not automatically explicit denigration of Explosion as chosen art.

records.whole_selected_premise: A real confidence gain permits a same-party request, but renewed attack interrupts the moment and reveals finite remaining mana.
records.L_rationale: Repeated combat costs and interrupted communication are portable causal facts.
records.H_rationale: Yunyun initiates the proposal and defends the convoy again with guards.
records.eligibility_and_limits: The narrator’s failure to receive it is not proof it was never spoken.

records.whole_selected_premise: The unused specialist appropriates collective credit while refusing the night cast for a valid geometry reason and ignoring the helper’s new confidence.
records.L_rationale: Minimal assent and teeth-grinding contradict the narrator’s no-jealousy disclaimer.
records.H_rationale: Prudent current restraint, envy and bad reception coexist.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Do not reduce genuine friendly-fire judgment to a fake excuse simply because another motive exists.

records.whole_selected_premise: A third successful defense still earns an unearned we from the bystander, and a child’s gratitude briefly restores the actual workers.
records.L_rationale: Yunyun explicitly distinguishes her and the guards’ action from Megumin’s inclusive claim.
records.H_rationale: Guard work, fatigue, public correction and gratitude are actual.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Not three independent successes by Megumin or a harmless credit transfer.

records.whole_selected_premise: The pursuer demands a paid-for cat, rejects a real refund proposal and discloses that she herded the supposedly flag-summoned monsters.
records.L_rationale: A later causal confession distinguishes deliberate surveillance from an unsupported genre law.
records.H_rationale: Horse killing, pursuit and monster herding impose real danger.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Arnes’s no-use-therefore-no-magic inference remains wrong despite correct observation of prior nonuse.

records.whole_selected_premise: A request to relocate the duel fails because the opponent uses wounded civilians as leverage and no longer follows the earlier bait.
records.L_rationale: Arnes’s explicit no-more-your-pace reply identifies competing control of the encounter.
records.H_rationale: More than twenty guards are overcome; hostages, spent Yunyun and constrained escape are actual.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Keeping people alive as leverage is not mercy or a safe prepared battlefield.

records.whole_selected_premise: An insult precipitates a cat toss and a real chant; an explicit warning of the pet’s death receives a familiar-duty justification rather than withdrawal.
records.L_rationale: The narrator’s cannot-back-down and future-grave account transparently assigns a cost the supposed familiar has not accepted.
records.H_rationale: Amplified pride recruits an actual known lethal sacrifice attempt against the valued pet.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Preserve literal intent and Yunyun’s veto. This choice begins before the later charging-fireball urgency; no H2 excuse, cat consent or immortality insurance.

records.whole_selected_premise: An unforeseen overwhelming aura distracts the enemy, the friend actually catches the cat, and the now-separated target receives the completed spell despite a plea to withdraw.
records.L_rationale: A calm spell-name answer after visible recovery contrasts with the enemy’s newly frightened negotiation.
records.H_rationale: Outside interruption changes geometry before execution; Megumin refuses mercy and wins the casting race.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Late luck and Yunyun’s rescue do not retrospectively supply Megumin’s original safe intention or a fully prepared operation.

records.whole_selected_premise: Peak output wins the acclaim that repeated useful defense did not secure, so the apparently weaker worker withdraws a proposal the celebrated mage cannot remember.
records.L_rationale: Always-believed crowd claims conflict with earlier complaints; the gentle retraction presupposes an invitation missed by its recipient.
records.H_rationale: Actual exhausted caster, wounded convoy, independent invitation and its withdrawal remain real.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No full healing receipt, guaranteed permanent devil extinction or proof that only the final strike mattered.

records.whole_selected_premise: The arriving pair’s excitement and inability to return register as a disturbance to the sleepy future companion passing by.
records.L_rationale: The boy’s enthusiastic work promise and girl’s emphatic cannot-return correction have opposing current aims.
records.H_rationale: Megumin hears an unknown pair and avoids involvement.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Reader recognition and closing cast names do not give her an established Kazuma/Aqua relationship.

records.whole_selected_premise: A gift book returns to its lonely hero and loyal followers while the mage who missed her rival’s proposal hopes for people unafraid to approach her.
records.L_rationale: The repeated fictional defense is reframed by a new first-person unanswered wish.
records.H_rationale: A real inn room, cat and private reflection frame nested fiction.
records.eligibility_and_limits: The fable’s boy eventually called a demon king has no explicitly narrated transition or final duel outcome; repetition is one embedded story, not two trials.

records.whole_selected_premise: Repeated heroic cover framing advertises Yunyun’s turn without itself creating another event.
records.L_rationale: Posed title identification is portable.
records.H_rationale: The image is an actual representational artifact, not an extra combat.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Dagger pose does not establish a new skill or fight.

records.whole_selected_premise: Named promotional panels contrast grand work ambitions with food requests, worry and money-limited advice.
records.L_rationale: Utterance juxtaposition supplies unequal aims and a bounded offer.
records.H_rationale: Printed panels are actual promotional speech depictions.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Do not count a composite as a separate continuous chronology.

records.whole_selected_premise: A dramatic front panel couples enemy contempt for a noncasting mage with Yunyun’s defense of her greater capacity.
records.L_rationale: The explicit uselessness rebuttal separates present contribution from confidence in a companion.
records.H_rationale: A posed scene anticipates an actual later conflict without adding another trial.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Body timing, danger and actual choices control the confrontation.

records.whole_selected_premise: A fictional tourist article celebrates grand training and ordinary commercial places while its graduate interview dismisses ordinary magic.
records.L_rationale: Promotional and attributed interview voices have a different purpose from neutral geographical narration.
records.H_rationale: Arue-attributed fictional article and diagram are actual supplied paratext.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Unvisited sites, service quality and every promotional claim are not independently verified.

records.whole_selected_premise: A priest mistakes a prospective adventuring partner for a lifetime provider and seizes the encounter.
records.L_rationale: Flirtation uptake, future household assumptions and the boy’s release requests are opposed.
records.H_rationale: Actual unwanted pressure and escape are narrated from Cecily’s viewpoint.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Non-graphic; reduced resistance does not establish assent or a provider contract.

records.whole_selected_premise: A recipient of food who exhausts help invokes charity to justify taking bread intended for poor people, rejecting the late offer to take only that.
records.L_rationale: Poor-in-love opportunistically changes the eligibility category while others’ permission has a narrower scope.
records.H_rationale: Bread theft and prior benefactor loss are actual in the interlude.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Doctrinal assertion does not establish objective entitlement or a census of departed believers.

records.whole_selected_premise: The rescued woman’s private narration confirms her own offending behavior while admiring a rescuer who currently lacks those facts.
records.L_rationale: Self-description and victim framing address different audiences and preserve unequal information.
records.H_rationale: The interlude revisits the same rescue with newly disclosed private motives.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No second rescue counted; an unperformed revenge plan is not a completed act.

records.whole_selected_premise: A routine cleaning assignment is delegated for a private story about a child rather than for responsible work.
records.L_rationale: Task agreement is redirected by the promised report about a nonconsenting third party.
records.H_rationale: Cecily’s bargain and Zesta’s actual accepted assignment are literal.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No claim the subject agreed to the report or that cleaning was completed.

records.whole_selected_premise: A hidden food powder and a novice cleaner’s bicarbonate question backfill a strong accidental contamination route.
records.L_rationale: An ambiguous bag and wrong expected substance support a portable causal mix-up.
records.H_rationale: The offered bribe and questions are depicted; the actual pour is not.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Current pre-seal correction controls earlier handoff shorthand; strong inference is not a directly witnessed pour.

records.whole_selected_premise: A missing personal powder supply becomes the devil’s supposed theft just after a more mundane route has been shown to the reader.
records.L_rationale: Cecily assigns a convenient enemy as culprit without witnessing the alleged act.
records.H_rationale: Actual belief and accusation do not establish its truth.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Keep reader-only causal access distinct from Megumin and Cecily’s information.

records.whole_selected_premise: A purported sacred request for money reorients the congregation while the volunteer’s pleasure doctrine sends her toward a particular desired person.
records.L_rationale: Collective sacred interpretation and Cecily’s private easy-life/Megumin aim coexist.
records.H_rationale: Zesta reports a message and Cecily volunteers; those acts are actual.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No independent complete Aqua viewpoint, transferred loan, actual arrival or divine endorsement of harassment.

records.whole_selected_premise: Creator self-mockery and a warm illustrator relation gloss close the volume without a new fictional coda.
records.L_rationale: The playful suspicious-person/self-claimed-writer wording is the point of the author’s short closing joke.
records.H_rationale: Actual creator commentary is a paratextual performance.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Not verified biography or a behavioral/romantic override for the characters.
